batch_meta.notes: Batch 1 of 4. Covers the 10 highest-missingness peptides (dihexa, igf-1-lr3, 5-amino-1mq, foxo4-dri, cerebrolysin, follistatin-344, mk-677, dsip, kisspeptin, orforglipron) across all 5 buckets. Strict citations only; null + questions where unsupported. Finnrick has no completed COA test data for any of the 10 priority peptides; vendor-quality lab_grade/lab_score uniformly null. Vd filled only for kisspeptin-54 (Dhillo 2005). Cerebrolysin handled as a mixture per project rule. Injectable peptides receive first_pass='not_applicable'. Vendor pricing populated for 8 of 10 peptides (no pre-approval supply for orforglipron; cerebrolysin pricing deferred pending non-US vendor vetting). Dosing rows added for dihexa and dsip.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Procognitive / antidementia (preclinical only — no IND or registered human trial)
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: not_approved; no registered clinical trial; sold by research-chemical vendors as 'not for human use'
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Reported metabolic stability with prolonged plasma t1/2 of 12.68 days IV and 8.83 days IP in rodents; resistance to standard peptidase degradation engineered into the analog scaffold (McCoy 2013).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Only rodent PK published. No human PK, no Vd, no first-pass data.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Long R3 IGF-1 (research analog of mecasermin); not a registered drug program
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: None — research reagent; no FDA-approved indication. Native rhIGF-1 (mecasermin, Increlex) is FDA-approved for severe primary IGFD; LR3 analog is not.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: not_approved as drug; banned at all times under WADA Prohibited List S2.2 (peptide hormones / growth factors) and corresponding national codes (USADA).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Subcutaneous research-grade administration only; LR3 modification reduces IGFBP binding and extends apparent half-life vs native IGF-1 to several hours, but no formal human PK published for the LR3 analog.

regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Investigational NNMT inhibitor for diet-induced obesity (preclinical mouse efficacy; no registered human trial)
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: not_approved; no registered clinical trial; widely sold as research-chemical capsules.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Quaternary methylquinolinium scaffold; LC-MS/MS rat PK assay (Phelps 2021) reports oral bioavailability ~38.4%, oral t1/2 ~6.9 h, IV t1/2 ~3.8 h. Hepatic oxidative pathways implied by the bioavailability gap but not formally characterized.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Existing atlas record already cites Neelakantan 2018 and Phelps 2021. Vd not reported in either source; population-level human PK absent.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: FOXO4-DRI / 'Proxofim' (no sponsor program; D-retro-inverso peptide from Baar 2017)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Senolytic clearance of senescent cells (preclinical mouse only — IV/tail-vein administration; never tested in humans)
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: not_approved; no registered human clinical trial; sold as research peptide.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: D-retro-inverso modification confers resistance to standard L-peptide proteolysis; Baar et al. 2017 used systemic IV dosing in aged mice; no formal human PK characterization.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: No human PK exists. All efficacy data are rodent.

regulatory_pk_rows.regulator: Austrian BASG (national authority); not approved by EMA centralized procedure; not approved by US FDA
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Stroke and dementia (Alzheimer-type, vascular) per Austrian Summary of Product Characteristics; indications vary by market
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Marketed prescription neuropeptide preparation outside the US; not FDA-approved.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Mixture of low-MW neuropeptides (~25%) and free amino acids (~75%) from enzymatic porcine brain hydrolysate. Project rule: do not force single-molecule PK fields onto a mixture. EVER Pharma SmPC does not publish a normalized Vd/first-pass; component-level metabolism follows general proteolysis and amino-acid metabolism.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: rAAV1.CMV.huFollistatin344 (Mendell, Nationwide Children's Hospital / Ohio State). Trial phase: registered as Phase 1 on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT01519349); described as 'Phase 1/2a' in the Mendell 2014/2017 publications.
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Becker muscular dystrophy and sporadic inclusion-body myositis (intramuscular AAV gene transfer)
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Phase 1 trial completed (published as Phase 1/2a by investigators); not approved; no later-stage program registered as of 2026-04-26.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Trial used direct IM AAV gene transfer (cohort 1: 3x10^11 vg/kg/leg) with muscle acting as a secretory depot for circulating follistatin. Mendell 2014/2017 do not publish a normalized Vd or systemic PK for the encoded protein; FS344 is the alternatively spliced variant chosen for its 10-fold lower activin affinity vs FS288.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Ibutamoren / MK-0677 / L-163,191 (Merck; subsequently Reverse Pharmacology / Lumos Pharma)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Studied for adult GH deficiency, frailty, hip fracture recovery; never approved. Lumos Pharma OraGrowtH program (pediatric GHD) ongoing through 2024 but no marketing authorization.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: not_approved; banned in sport (WADA growth-hormone secretagogue category); sold by research-chemical vendors.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Existing atlas record (Patchett 1995; Chapman 1996; Nass 2008) already documents oral bioavailability with hydroxylation/oxidation metabolites consistent with CYP-mediated phase 1 metabolism of the spiroindane scaffold.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase2_metabolism: Glucuronide conjugates reported in human urine analyses (existing atlas citation).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: No published human Vd in the cited primary literature. First-pass extraction inferred from oral bioavailability data but not normalized as a single value.

regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Delta sleep-inducing peptide (Schoenenberger / Monnier discovery; Soviet-era clinical research)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Sleep induction, narcotic withdrawal, chronic insomnia — small uncontrolled human trials in the 1980s. Never registered for marketing in the US or EU.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Plasma t1/2 only several minutes - degraded by aminopeptidase-like enzymes that cleave the N-terminal Trp and subsequent Ala residues; brain-slice/homogenate proteolytic Trp split-off ~15 min (Kovalzon 2006).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Endogenous DSIP-IR material in plasma/urine/CSF is bound to a larger carrier protein, partially protecting it from proteolysis (Kovalzon 2006). No formal Vd or steady-state PK in human volunteers.

regulatory_pk_rows.regulator: MHRA (Imperial College academic IND); FDA (academic INDs at Mass General/Harvard via Seminara group)
regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Kisspeptin-54 / kisspeptin-10 - academic Phase 1/2 program (Dhillo, Jayasena, Comninos, Imperial College; Seminara, MGH)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Triggering oocyte maturation in IVF for women at high risk of OHSS (Phase 2, NCT01667406); hypothalamic amenorrhea; functional reproductive endocrinology
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: investigational; no marketing authorization. Multiple academic Phase 1/2 trials completed.
regulatory_pk_rows.vd_population: Six healthy adult males, 90-min IV infusion of kisspeptin-54 at 4 pmol/kg/min (Dhillo 2005, JCEM)
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Endopeptidase / aminopeptidase degradation typical of small peptides; t1/2 of kisspeptin-54 = 27.6 +/- 1.1 min, MCR = 3.2 +/- 0.2 ml/kg/min (Dhillo 2005). Kisspeptin-10 t1/2 ~4 min (shorter due to smaller size).
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Vd value above is the only published human normalized Vd in the priority-10 set. Kisspeptin-10 PK characterized separately in rat (Pubmed 24447471).

regulatory_pk_rows.jurisdiction: United States; Global (>40 markets per Lilly)
regulatory_pk_rows.regulator: FDA; EMA; PMDA; multiple national authorities
regulatory_pk_rows.brand_or_program: Orforglipron / LY3502970 - ATTAIN Phase 3 program (Eli Lilly)
regulatory_pk_rows.approved_or_studied_indication: Obesity (ATTAIN-1 NCT05869903, 72-wk vs placebo); obesity + T2D (ATTAIN-2 NCT05872620); type-2 diabetes (ACHIEVE program). Lilly has filed for obesity in 2025 and plans T2D filings in 2026.
regulatory_pk_rows.current_marketing_status: Not yet approved as of 2026-04-26; potential US action for obesity in Q2 2026 per Lilly disclosures.
regulatory_pk_rows.phase1_metabolism: Small-molecule non-peptide GLP-1 RA. Pratt 2023 Phase 1a reports dose-proportional PK with single-dose t1/2 24.6-35.3 h (0.3-6 mg) and steady-state t1/2 48.1-67.5 h (2-24 mg, day 28); Tmax 2-4 h; oral bioavailability ~30-40%. Hepatic oxidative metabolism implied by oral bioavailability gap, but a normalized phase-1 enzyme attribution is not published in the cited primary sources.
regulatory_pk_rows.pk_note: Pratt 2023 does not report a Vd value. Existing atlas already cites Lilly corporate page; this row adds the registrational PK paper.

dosing_rows.population: Adult Sprague-Dawley rats; aged Tg2576 mouse models
dosing_rows.frequency: single dose or short course (1-7 days) in McCoy 2013 protocols
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Used to demonstrate cognitive rescue in scopolamine-impaired rodents; not a human protocol
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Reversed scopolamine-induced spatial memory deficit and rescued cognitive function in aged Tg2576 mice; circulating t1/2 12.68 d (IV) / 8.83 d (IP).

dosing_rows.use_label: Sleep induction and chronic-pain insomnia (1980s human studies)
dosing_rows.population: Adult human volunteers; chronic-pain patients with insomnia
dosing_rows.frequency: single dose (some studies repeated nightly for 5 days)
dosing_rows.schedule_detail: Schoenenberger / Monnier-era protocols; not modern controlled trials
dosing_rows.effect_summary: Reported reduced sleep onset, increased sleep time, and improved sleep efficiency without classical sedation in small uncontrolled human trials; transient headache, nausea, vertigo reported in some volunteers.
